2. The prosecution case, in brief, is that opposite party No. 1 as complainant filed CR Case No. 53 of 1998 on 21-4-1998 against the petitioner in the court of Magistrate 1st Class, Munshiganj, under sections 406/407/408 of the Penal Code alleging, inter alia, that the complainant was the Headmaster-in-charge of Khash Mahal Baluchar High School of Sirajdikhan, and the accused petitioner Abdul Barek was the Assistant Teacher of the said school and that a cheque bearing No. 5075365 dated 9-9-93 signed by both Newaz Ali the then President of the School Managing Committee and Alim Badsha, the then Headmaster of the School for an amount of Taka 65,763 for development of the school and handed over the same to the petitioner to encash the cheque from Sonali Bank, Baluchar Branch and after encashment of the cheque the petitioner did not pay the money to the Managing Committee and despite repeated reminders the money was not paid to the Managing Committee and thereby misappropriated the money. 

 14. DW 1 Md Alim Badsha, the then Headmaster of Baluchar Khas Mahal High School, deposed that in the Register of the school the purpose for withdrawal of the money was mentioned and that the proposal was noted as to pay the salary to the teachers and the staffs for July, August and September, 1993, to purchase question papers for 2nd terminal examination and to purchase papers, etc. Accordingly, a cheque bearing No. 5075365 for Taka 65,763 was issued and it was encashed and Taka 50,763 was disbursed and the rest Taka 15,000 remained due to the complainant (PW 1) who was Headmaster-in-charge of the school as he was on sick leave during that time and also deposed that he filed an application to the Bureau of Anti-Corruption against the complainant for misappropriation of Taka 15,000. 

 15. Out of 4 witnesses, the complainant (PW 1) now the Headmaster of Khash Mohal Baluchar High School was the Assistant Head-master and Headmaster-in-charge of the school during the alleged occurrence. PW 2 being a teacher of the school contested with the petitioner in the election of the teacher's representative held in 1993 but was defeated and the petitioner was elected. Later on, in 1994 he was elected member of the teacher's representative. PW 3 a teacher who was also a teacher's representative member in the Managing Committee of the school in 1993. PW 4 a donor member of the School Managing Committee who has been holding such post for the last 25 years.
